text:
Olivia Nguyen: Support case — embeddings changed size after v1->v2 swap. Quickstart didn't pin model id.
Matt Chen: Repro?
Olivia Nguyen: `client.embed({ input: 'hello' })` -> alias resolved to `embed_xsmall` (128d) vs expected 1536d. Customer index broke.
Raj Patel: That needs a migration warning + snippet update. Silent fallthrough is dangerous.
Sophia Li: I'll draft a migration paragraph and an inline banner: 'Verify embedding model and vector dimensionality after migration; pin model IDs in production.'
Matt Chen: I'll update quickstart snippets (TS/Py) to explicitly set `model: 'h2o-embed-1536'`.
Raj Patel: I'll add a non-blocking docs CI smoke test that runs the embed snippet and asserts len(vec) == 1536, gated by docs-owner label to avoid noisy failures.
docs-bot: Issue opened: "docs: embed alias dimensionality caveat" (#5100)
ci-bot: Smoke test queued: docs-embed-dim-check
ci-bot: Smoke test PASS (vector dim 1536)
Olivia Nguyen: Merged the docs + snippet PRs and added changelog entry. I'll follow up with comms and update support templates.
